title: Exploring the Feasibility of Kōmmour Prenatal to Reduce Maternal and Infant Health Disparities
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to culturally adapt and examine the feasibility of a group prenatal program (Kōmmour Prenatal) to reduce maternal and infant health disparities among Marshallese Pacific Islander women in the US. The study will also gather information from providers of Kōmmour Prenatal and stakeholders in the Marshallese community familiar with the program to learn of their experience with the program.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Women who self-identify as Marshallese
* 18 years of age or older
* And 8-20 weeks pregnant

Exclusion Criteria

* Women who do not self-identify as Marshallese
* Not 18 years of age or older
* And not 8-20 weeks pregnant
condition: Kōmmour Prenatal Among Marshallese Pregnant Women
